newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE - W.Areas posts June quarter net loss.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - W.Areas posts June quarter net loss.

text.p: Results for the quarter to end-June versus preceding quarter.
Net loss before capital spending 12.90 vs 6.90 profit
Full name: Western Areas Gold Mining Co Ltd, a unit of JCI Ltd
NOTE - The company said it expected recovered grades to improve in the next quarter due to mining of higher grade areas.
Total tonnes milled were expected to rise gradually to a monthly average of 250,000 tonnes while unit costs should decrease over the quarter.
Improvements have been made in the SV2/3 area with respect to technical problems which previously hampered production.
The company said public holidays and the June 2 worker stay-away had a major effect on productivity in the June quarter.
